title: Company coverage is a curated seed set
detail: 11 sourced company records versus 2,117 GCCs in India. The set shows the evidence method; it is not a representative sample of the market, and counts by city or sector should not be read as market shares.

title: No comparable operating-cost data
detail: Rents, fully loaded compensation and utilities by city were not found in sources Atlas can cite, so Location Compare shows 'Data unavailable' for operating costs.

title: Official incentive text missing for three states
detail: Official policy documents for Karnataka, Telangana and Tamil Nadu were not located (Karnataka's IT department site blocks automated access; Telangana's GCC policy is reported as a draft). Their incentive records are labelled unverified. Maharashtra's is the official GR.

title: City-level GCC counts and sector mix
detail: Zinnov's landing page does not expose city or sector cuts, and the only available Chennai GCC count cites no underlying data. City depth relies on secondary sources relaying JLL and CBRE.

title: Static snapshot, no live feed
detail: All records are a snapshot read on 11 Oct 2026. Nothing in the app updates automatically, and 'recent activity' means recent source dates, not live news.
